svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.05k stars in total, about 1.68k a year earlier. jactionlint 301, mr boxington 638, aube 2057, fnox 2342, hk 1293, pitchfork 700, usage 1066, +5 more 654.
